rules.statement: A donor may expressly reserve a power of revocation and exercise it himself, even if the gift is not an irrevocable remuneratory donation.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not see any principle disentitling a donor to do so. Since a gift is purely voluntary, and as it is in the power of the donor to give the property absolutely or a limited interest therein, I think that it is not contrary to law if he makes a transitory gift, such as a gift to be terminated by his own act."
